title: Motor-controller mounting bracket BW-5120-210, Rev B to Rev C: fillet fatigue crack
basis: Options are decisions on the ECR run through the same cost, timeline and supply checks with one seed. Ranked on the 12-month total at p50.

options.label: Use up the old stock, Do not retrofit built aircraft

overrides.rationale: Option: cut in at S/N 33, the first serial after the old stock is used up (timeline check).

exclusions.reason: This change fixes a failure, so building or fitting more of the old design is not allowed unless certification accepted it.

evidence.quote: MRB 2026-10-09: Rev B is not acceptable for flight.
Filed after NCR-0119, a non-conformance record.
NCR-0119: crack at the lower fillet at 8.2 h of the 20 h endurance profile; three of twelve rig brackets have initiated by 20 h.
Rig EP-3, controller position 4: crack at 8.2 h, 14 mm from flange edge into web.

exclusions.reason: The ECR or its non-conformance record makes the retrofit of built aircraft mandatory.

evidence.quote: MRB 2026-10-09: Rev B is not acceptable for flight.
Replace Rev B on S/N 001-010 with Rev C; returned Rev B is scrapped.

exclusions.reason: The ECR or its non-conformance record makes the retrofit of built aircraft mandatory.

Schedule: the change reaches the line about 13 weeks after the date stated.
